description: This Java class 'EnumConfigField' provides a UI component for configuring enum-type fields within an application. It manages a combo box for selecting enum options, listens for external messages to update its value, and communicates user selections back to the system.

classes.name: EnumConfigField
classes.description: A UI component for selecting enumeration options in a configuration system.

methods.name: EnumConfigField
methods.description: Constructor initializing the combo box with options and setting up message listeners.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the combo box selection based on an ordinal integer.

methods.name: loadValue
methods.description: Loads a value from ConfigurationImage and updates the combo box selection.
